answer: Divergent-Response Challenge Mechanism. Each identity must answer a random challenge derived from a shared violet seed, and responses are scored against neighbors’ divergence patterns. Clones produce identical replies, so a sybil cluster collapses into one detected equivalence class. Enforcement: any identity whose response history shows zero divergence from another is flagged ferrous, losing its standing. The attacker must maintain distinct, coherent behavior per clone, costing ongoing per-identity inference and a willow-thin margin before correlation exposes the whole set.
